payload.title: Promote RangerCRM's client observation tier into FrickSwift
payload.description:
FrickSwift today is a thin transport: FrickClient (CRUD/auth/blobs/search), FrickSyncSocket (raw delta frames), and SwiftUI wrappers for append-only event streams + presence only (@FrickStream / @FrickPresence in packages/swift/Sources/FrickSwift/SwiftUI/FrickStream.swift). It has NO concept of an observable, live-updating collection of domain objects.

RangerCRM built that entire missing tier itself, in /Users/bri/dev/RangerCRM/RangerCRM/Model/RangerData/ (~9,300 LOC — roughly 2x the size of FrickSwift's own ~4,800 LOC). It is generic, app-agnostic infrastructure that the next Frick app would otherwise re-derive from fetchObjects(). This epic relocates that tier down into FrickSwift and de-duplicates it (RangerCRM currently copy-pastes the store ~16x).

Layer cake today:
  app views (@FrickQuery, sign-in UI)
  OBSERVATION TIER  <- lives in RangerCRM (FrickStore x16, *FrickModel x16, @FrickQuery, FrickSessionManager, FrickSharingService, DataController bridge)
  FrickSwift SDK (FrickClient, FrickSyncSocket, @FrickStream/@FrickPresence, Keychain session persistence)

Goal after this epic: FrickSwift owns the object-observation tier (observable store + @FrickQuery + observable model wrappers + store registry); RangerCRM sheds ~5,000 LOC and one security regression (see the session story); a new Frick app starts where RangerCRM is now instead of at fetchObjects().

Suggested sequence: Store -> Registry -> @FrickQuery -> Session -> Sharing -> Model macro. Each story self-describes its Frick-today baseline, what RangerCRM built, and the delta the port adds.

Reference (read-only) for every story: RangerCRM's working implementations under /Users/bri/dev/RangerCRM/RangerCRM/Model/RangerData/ — these are battle-tested and should be the porting source of truth.
